verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents running code in an isolated cloud computer (docs-1). It also offers process contexts that can be stateful REPLs or stateless commands (docs-21), and supports custom images, which implies arbitrary runtimes can be installed (docs-23, docs-24). The evidence never names Python or JavaScript runtimes specifically and never describes structured rich outputs. Missing for 10: explicit multi-language runtime support (Python, JS, others), rich result types such as charts, images or structured data returned from execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.
